transcript.content: Hello, welcome to the clinic. What brings you in to see me today?

Um... hi. I guess I'm mostly here because my sleep has basically... fallen apart. 

I just... I'll lie in bed in my apartment for hours. My laptop will be closed, but I'm just laying there, mentally rechecking work deadlines... and tuition payments, class assignments. It just kind of keeps going. And, um... even when I do manage to sleep, I wake up feeling like I never really turned off. 

So... yeah. That's why I'm here.
Do you find yourself worrying excessively about everyday things, even when there's no apparent reason to worry?

Yeah... I guess you could say that. It's just... my mind jumps around a lot. 

From worrying if I'm falling behind at work... to whether I'm wasting money on school. And... I don't know, worrying my family will think I can't handle things. I just kind of treat every small issue like it's... going to derail my whole future, I guess.
Has something traumatic happened to you recently or in the past?
No... nothing like that. I mean, my life's been pretty normal, honestly. Just... the usual stuff. Nothing traumatic.
Do you experience sudden episodes of intense fear or discomfort?
Um... no, not really. I don't think so. It's not... sudden, like that. It's just sort of always there in the background. But no... no episodes.
Do you find yourself avoiding certain activities or situations because of your worries?
Um... not really. I mean, I still go to work and do what I need to do. I don't think I avoid things... I just worry about them while I'm doing them.
Do you experience any physical symptoms like headaches or muscle tension when you're worrying?
Um... no, not really. I don't think so. I haven't really paid attention to that, to be honest. I mean... I don't think I get headaches from it or anything.
Have you been feeling sad or empty most of the time lately?
I wouldn't say sad, no. I mean... I have a lot on my mind, obviously, but... I don't feel empty. Just... normal, I guess, other than the worrying.
Do you often feel restless or on edge?
Um... I'm not really sure. I don't think so. I mean, I sit at my desk most of the day for work, so... I wouldn't really say I feel restless. Just... normal.
Do you often feel nervous or anxious in general?

Um... yeah, I guess so. It's just... my mind keeps jumping around a lot. Like... I'll worry about falling behind at work, and then I'll start worrying if I'm wasting money on school. Or... I'll think about my family, and if they think I can't handle things. I don't know. I guess I just treat every little issue like it's going to... derail my whole future. So... yeah.
Is there one main thing that you worry about most of the time?
Um... no. Not really. I don't think there's just... one main thing. It just kind of shifts around to different stuff, I guess. So... no.
How long have you been experiencing this excessive worrying?

Um... a while, I guess. Maybe... like, a year and three months? It kind of started around the time I began this... evening graduate certificate program. I'm still working my full-time analyst job, so... yeah. Since I started doing both, I guess.
Does your worrying affect your relationships with friends and family?
Um... I don't know. I haven't really... paid attention to that. I guess I don't really see them as much right now, with work and school... so, I don't know.
Do you think your worrying is interfering with your ability to enjoy or perform daily activities?

Um... yeah, I guess so. I mean... I've been missing some deadlines at work lately. And... I'm kind of falling behind in my classes, too. I just... I don't really do the things I used to do anymore. Like... I used to run, and do yoga, and... cook my own meals. But I just... I stopped doing all that. So... yeah.
Do you worry about things almost every day?

Um... yeah. Pretty much every day. It's just... my mind kind of jumps around a lot. Like, I'll worry about falling behind at work, and then... I'll start thinking about school and if I'm just wasting my money on it. And then... I don't know, I guess I worry about what my family thinks, like if they think I can't handle it all. It just feels like... every little thing that goes wrong could just... derail everything. So... yeah, it's every day.
Do you feel like your worrying is causing you a lot of distress?

Um... I don't really know. I guess... I haven't really thought of it like that. It's just a lot to deal with. But I don't know if I'd use the word distress, exactly... it's just kind of how things are right now.
Is your worrying present across most areas of your life, such as work, school, and personal relationships?
Um... I guess so. Yeah. I mean, I already mentioned work and school, so... yeah, it's there. And I guess with my family, too. It just... it kind of spills over into everything, I suppose.
Do you feel like you're able to control your worrying when you want to?

Um... no. Not really. I try to... I try to tell myself to just stop, you know? Just focus on one thing. But... it doesn't work. One worry just kind of... leads right into another one. And then... I end up just checking my calendar, and my budget, and my work assignments... over and over. Instead of actually getting anything done. So... no, I can't really control it.
Do you feel anxious or fearful when you're worrying about these everyday things?

Um... I suppose so. I don't know if I'd use the word fearful, but... yeah. My mind just keeps jumping around. Like... I'll be worrying that I'm falling behind at work, and then it just switches to... whether I'm wasting my money on school. And then I start thinking about my family, and if they're going to think I can't handle things. It's just... I end up treating every little issue like it's going to completely derail my whole future. So... I guess that makes me anxious, yeah.
Do you think your worrying has been present for more than six months?

Yeah... it has. Um... probably for about a year and three months now. That's... that's when I started my evening graduate certificate program. I kept my full-time job as an analyst, so... yeah. It's been going on since then.
Have you noticed any significant problems at work or in your personal relationships because of your worrying?

Um... yeah, I guess. I mean... I've been missing some deadlines at work lately. And... falling behind in my classes. I just... I don't really do the things I used to do anymore. Like yoga, or running... I don't even really cook now. I just... don't.
